provenance.writtenFor: DAST app-surface batch 4 (2026-10-21): console, error-page, served-artefact and cookie-domain evidence the App forwards
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A response carries the evidence DPK-DAST-339 declares: apache error log served as a response.

groundTruth.rationale: The synthetic response reproduces the exact evidence DPK-DAST-339 inspects, in a realistic response for that failure mode, with the rest of the response left ordinary so the finding is attributable to this one property.

observation.body:
[Sun May 11 09:14:02.123456 2024] [core:error] [pid 812] [client 203.0.113.7] AH00037: Symbolic link not allowed or link target not accessible: /var/www/shop/uploads
[Sun May 11 09:14:09.000111 2024] [php:warn] [pid 812] PHP Warning:  include(/var/www/shop/config.php): failed to open stream

detections.mustContain: AH00037: Symbolic link not allowed or link target not accessible: /var/www/shop/uploads

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
A positive case proves the rule fires on this evidence; it is not a claim that a live target behaves the same way.
